The countervailing discipline actually applied: Kim's figure rests on an aggregator abstract, which is not a rung on the R10 ladder, so it is staged and explicitly marked not-to-be-cited; Lepoglavec's figures rest on a publisher-deposited abstract, which is, so they are filed but as preliminary skim rows. A second bias ran the other way and was corrected mid-batch by owner directive: I scoped the batch to STATED VALUES and was discarding qualitative and argument-level sources as secondary, which would have lost REF-00977 and REF-01000 entirely.
